why: Collapses the two boundaries back into one. The same thrown object means different things depending on where it was caught: during boot the game never came up, while from a match start the player has already watched a Main Menu work and clicked a button on it. Under this mutation a failed match tells them "Tanks! could not start" over a menu they can see running, which reads as the message being broken rather than the match. `boot.ts` recorded this case as a hole when issue #428 created it.
killedBy: boot: the message itself classifies each cause into its own state, and guesses at nothing
boot: the shell capability probe (issue #470) still catches a session that fails for a reason the probe cannot see
